integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically. Finite enumeration is corroborative only and is not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the high-defect tail; lower \(k\)-defect values of crown graphs are not classified. An older equivalent formulation through cut or Tutte-polynomial language remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Nontrivial edge cuts determine the high-defect tail of the \(k\)-defect number
